messages:
nina: heads up — ap-southeast1 tiny-gang evictions starting 02:12 UTC, looks like a sudden network reachability issue for a subset of GPU nodes :warning:
oliver: confirming, nodes gpu-node-apse1-{30..38} flapped NotReady around 02:11. kubelet logs show lost peer connections to metadata service
hara: saw an iptables change pushed this morning to the node-init script, could that have clobbered the NAT rules? infra-bot shows deploy at 01:59 UTC
infra-bot: deploy: node-init-config by infra@redwood (change-id: cfg-2026-03-18-77). Modified iptables post-up sequence (removed legacy nat restore)
sam: removing NAT restore on nodes would break pod egress briefly during interface bounce — kube-proxy conntrack entries get stale and kubelet marks network not ready
ina: pasted small kubelet snippet: ```E0318 02:11:06 kubelet_network.go:210] NetworkPlugin cni failed: failed to ensure nat rules: exec: "iptables-restore": executable file not found in $PATH```
oliver: right there. nodes couldn't apply iptables -> CNI failed -> pods network dead -> scheduler preempted tiny-gang jobs to other nodes and then evicted when pressure rose
hara: mitigation: rolled back node-init-config to previous commit and restarted kubelet on affected nodes. also bumped warmpool-min 2->5 for 20m to soak the rescheduling pressure
ops-bot: action created: NET-5082 investigate iptables-restore removal (assigned to infra)
infa-bot: (typo) infra-bot: rollbacks applied at 02:18 UTC; watching nodes
sam: metrics: pod_evictions spiked 5 -> 48 in 7m, now down to 7 after rollback. recommend postmortem: validate node-init scripts in canary and add test for presence of iptables-restore binary on image
nina: cost note: temporary warmpool bump ~+$3.2k if sustained 24h; short window negligible but flagging
oliver: follow-ups: 1) revert node-init change permanently until canary passes; 2) add integration test for CNI+iptables during interface restart; 3) alert if "pods_preempted_per_min > 10" in GPU pools
hara: agreed. i'll open NET-5083 for canary pipeline and AUTOSCALE-509 for alerting
nina: summary: cause = node-init iptables change removed iptables-restore -> CNI failure -> nodes NotReady -> scheduler preempts -> eviction spike; mitigation = rollback + kubelet restart + warmpool bump; follow-ups created. thanks everyone.
